done_when: The review record no longer writes or refreshes the tree key (review.py whole_tree and its callers in review.py and close.py are removed), and forge.toml's old top-level model line gets the ordinary unknown-key refusal instead of its own hint (the old_model refusal is removed); tests that pinned either are updated to the new contract, and nothing else changes.
why: Forge still carries compatibility code for clients that no longer exist: the review record's tree key kept only for v1.1.0's pull-request check, and a special hint for an old top-level model line in forge.toml
